# Pinned AndroidX slider source

See `sources.json` for exact source revision, raw URLs and SHA-256 hashes.
The original Apache license headers are retained in all four Kotlin files.
`drawing-oracle.json`, `pointer-oracle.json` and `input-state-oracle.json` are regenerated by
`tools/androidx-sliders/snapshot.mjs` from unchanged drawing/snapping and scalar
pointer-dispatch/state-update bodies. Foundation's Draggable.kt and DragGestureDetector.kt
also document the source cancellation and slop behavior; their coroutine runtime
is not executed by the scalar recorder. See the tool's README for the scope and
explicit platform boundaries.
